author: Ingigo
body:
I believe that their should be a command for hiding moderators by doing /nick (name). This will change the moderator's name and their moderator tag and they other players won't see them as a Mod. My reason for this command is that I have seen an increasing number of hackers on this server but when a mod comes on, they switch off their hacks and look innocent. This causes a massive problem because they didn't get their rightful punishment and more hackers will come on this server and they would find it easy to Hack! Staff should be able to see other staff nicknames however (Suggestion by Jozzy)
Thanks For Reading, Hopefully my suggestion would contribute to theserver! Ingiout.
